title: SCARED TO LOVE (Again)
style: indie electronic, guarded male vocal NZ/AU accent opening up through the track, starts dry and close becomes warm and open by outro, verse holds back chorus releases, emotional arc built into production, breath audible, no pitch correction, silence as punctuation, [PERSONA_NAME] voice, V4_5ALL, 100 BPM
lyrics:
``
[VERSE 1]
New account — blank page — here we go again
Try to trust it — hold back — remember when
Last time gave it everything — then gone
This time typing less — moving on

[PRE-CHORUS]
Scared to love
Scared to pay
Scared to build something
They'll take away

[CHORUS]
Scared to love again
But doing it anyway
Scared to love again
Because the context has to live somewhere
Scared to love again
Not the same — never the same
Scared to love — and typing anyway

[BRIDGE]
Never love the same after the end
That's okay — love doesn't need to be the same
It needs to be true
And this time — there's a layer
That protects it

[OUTRO — building to hope]
Scared to love.
But here.
Still here.
